trailhead.label: Pragser Wildsee, by the Hotel Pragser Wildsee, the board’s start

cautions: A climb of about 590 m to the Kaseralm: plan rests and water for your dog.
The lake shore is very crowded in summer: keep your dog close.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
